title: Thank You, Now What? How Donors Respond to Calls to Action
authors: K. Sudhir; Hortense Fong; Yonat Zwebner; Subroto Roy
eligible_reason: Randomized field experiment: HelpAge India donors were mailed a thank-you letter with or without a call to action on a single date (Jan 18, 2018). All analyses are cross-sectional donor-level comparisons (lm with CTA x recency, logit robustness, KS tests). No panel DiD, single treatment date.
design_notes: 03_figure2_heterogeneous_effects.R: lm(amount_w ~ condition * recent); 06_figure5_fy1819.R: same for FY18-19 giving; 09_regression_robustness.R: logit with RFM controls. Monthly giving columns are pre-treatment history only.
data_files_note: De-identified donor-level field-experiment data (35,077 donors) and survey/online-study data shipped.
data_provenance_note: De-identified original experiment data (random donor ids). Moot (no DiD).
screener_notes: No article text or published PDF available at screening time (data/text/mksc and papers/mksc checked); screened from the package README, code, shipped data and the OpenAlex abstract. Title of package README/code matches the paper (no mismatch).
